_source: Turck BI3U-EG12SK-VP4X inductive sensor, recorded product page (287 kB). Verified in the page: `IP68` ×5, `Stainless steel` ×5, `1.4301` ×5 (AISI 304 housing grade), `85` (max ambient). The page states ambient temperature as two SEPARATE rows with the unit in the label — `Ambient temperature min. (°C) = -30` and `Ambient temperature max. (°C) = 85`.
_tier: value-verified. Chosen for promotion as the LOWEST-yield fixture in the corpus (27 attributes from a 287 kB page), on the theory that a low yield hides MISSED data — the opposite failure mode from the high-yield fixtures. It did.

_notes.temperature_min_max: This fixture found P1.4a. Both temperature rows WERE extracted as attributes, yet operatingTemperatureMin/Max came out empty: `deriveOperatingTemperature` only ever looked for a range inside ONE value, and never paired two separate min/max rows. The unit lives in the label (`(°C)`) and the value is a bare number, which is the norm for sensor vendors (Turck, Balluff, IFM). The pairing reuses parseQuantities for the unit so °F rows convert rather than needing their own code path.
_notes.title: This fixture also found P1.4b: `title` was `Sign up to our Newsletter` — a newsletter widget marked up as an h1 ahead of the product heading. Worse than cosmetic, because `confirmsIdentity` in quality-gate.ts looks for the catalog number IN THE TITLE, so page furniture there also weakens identity confirmation.
_notes.title_tradeoff: Fixing it exposed a trade-off worth recording. Preferring the heading that NAMES the catalog number looked tidier but was worse — Rockwell's title became `1606-XLS120E` instead of `XLS Power Supply 120W 24VDC 5A`, trading a description a human can read for an identifier the row already carries in its own column. The vendor's own product heading wins; the catalog match is the fallback for when that heading is unusable, which is exactly this page.
_notes.commerce_chrome: The `mustNotContain` price/stock/cart entries pin P1.1d, which this same page found earlier: `In StockPrice GroupE1List Price102,70 € … add_shopping_cartAdd to cart` had been emitted as a product attribute.
_notes.not_asserted: `finish = Threaded barrel` is a housing DESIGN, not a surface finish — a mis-mapping, so it is deliberately left unasserted rather than blessed.
